spec: Principia/Record/Check.lean: the DERIVATION's three forms, their preimage, the PMA row DERIVATION_CLASS, and a bare KERNEL refused REC-44; the texts inside a derivation read as the derivation command reads them, and record_view's step count
note: hand-written: the record check reads a DERIVATION by its shape; expectations are literals in TPM's canonical JSON; the preimage and digest cases RF16 to RF34 were written from the Calculator and checked outside it: each DERIVATION field equal to the input's canonical JSON (keys sorted, no space) and each digest equal to SHA-256 of the field list's netstrings; the DERIVATION_CLASS cases RF35 to RF50 were written from the Calculator and checked outside it: each preimage version 1's field list with the row appended and counted, each digest SHA-256 of its netstrings, the three classes three digests, none version 1's; the cases at LANDED without the row expect REC-43 since the row was added; the text cases RF51 to RF69 (each text inside a derivation read as the derivation command reads it, a failure REC-41 at the text's own path) and the view cases RF70 to RF74 (a STRUCTURED derivation's steps as their count) were written from the Calculator and checked against pcalc derivation credit_record on the same derivations: every structured text refused here is one that command answers UNREADABLE with the same word, every name refused here one it answers REFUSED missing-citation; the bare KERNEL cases (RF03, RF17, RF54 to RF56, RF67 and RF75, REC-44 at PUSH and at LANDED) and RF76 (PROSE with a KERNEL attachment landed INSPECTION, its digest from record_digest) were written from the Calculator
